_about: What the web site and the web flasher show for this radio (docs/dev/website.md). Hardware facts stay in docs/spec. Bring-up: nothing here has run on an MD-9600 yet (hardware-md9600.md 14.4).
name: TYT MD-9600

bootloader: Disconnect the radio's DC power cable (the power key alone is not enough) and connect the USB cable to the mini-USB port on the rear.
Hold P1 and the orange (alarm) key while you connect the power again. The display flashes, then stays blank. Not yet confirmed on a radio: one report names the red key instead of the orange one.
